messages:
mina: Quick sync: onboarding sampleapp keeps retrying on bad payloads. We're surfacing a single BadRequest in multiple SDKs so client code retries.

jorge: Can you paste an example server body?

mina: Sure: `{ "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "message": "metadata: expected object, got string" } }`. Older infra sometimes only returns status + plain text.

anya: Root cause: SDKs collapse 4xx into one typed BadRequest. That means apps can't tell retriable from non-retriable. We should add richer typed exceptions and a stable code.

mina: Proposal: SDKs map `error.kind` (or fallback heuristics) to typed classes: ParseError, ValidationError, AuthError, RateLimitError. Each error object should include: `code` (stable machine id), `retriable` (bool), `help_url` (optional), and `request_id`/`error_id` when present.

jorge: For parity: update JS/TS, Go, and Python SDKs. Keep mapping logic identical (shared table in repo?) or at least document the canonical mapping in docs.

anya: Server ask: please standardize `error.kind` and add an optional `code` and `retriable` on the error JSON. If not possible immediately, SDKs should implement heuristic fallbacks: `Retry-After` header => RateLimit, message contains 'token' or 'auth' => AuthError, message contains 'expected'/'invalid' => Parse/Validation.

infra-bot: Ticket created: DX-3001 standardize error payloads. Linked to this thread.

mina: UX note: change sampleapp retry policy to only retry when err.retriable === true. Also show the help_url and machine code in the UI with friendly copy: "We couldn't process your metadata (ERR_PARSE_METADATA). See help or contact support with request id."

jorge: Tests: unit tests for mapping table, e2e where sampleapp sends malformed metadata to confirm no retry loop, and CI fixtures updated. Add assertion that thrown errors include `retriable` boolean.

anya: Migration note: call out integrators that matched on message text — they should switch to `err.code` or `err.retriable`. We'll include examples in the changelog.

mina: Who takes SDK PRs? jorge -> TS/Py, mina -> Go, anya -> docs & sampleapp. Target: small patch this week to reduce support noise.

jorge: I'll open the TS PR with tests by Friday. Will include a concise mapping table and fallback heuristics.

anya: I'll draft the docs and sampleapp README update, including example log entries that include request_id/error_id.

mina: Thanks all. Small change but should significantly cut onboarding retries. :+1:
